data.notes: It gets the header right, including the international-only split in the reason. It also lands the key messaging moves: replace the A1 average with the customer's own numbers, have an answer to 'local acquiring', and say 'approvals' not 'authorization'. It misses the core finding that the account had no coverage (no review in 9–10 months, never met the new head of payments, stakeholder change unnoticed) and the named monthly owner, and the decider/message and trigger/proof pairs largely repeat each other.
